title: Children who witnessed the Irkutsk lights
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Children who witnessed the Irkutsk lights, about 2011 at Irkutsk Oblast, Siberia, Russia, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I heard a rumble, and then I saw a pink light. Everything was lit with pink color. I thought it was an alien.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, plays a report from Russian Channel 1, a Russian television channel, about strange lights seen around 2011 in the Irkutsk region of Siberia. In it, children who saw the event describe hearing a rumble and then seeing a pink light that colored everything around them, and one says, "I thought it was an alien."
